sections.section_title: Slave mode – combined reset + trigger mode
sections.text_helper: Section 56.4.18 "Slave mode – combined reset + trigger mode" in chapter 56 (General-purpose timers (TIM9/TIM10/TIM11/TIM12/TIM13/TIM14)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2789.
sections.section_content:
In this case, a rising edge of the selected trigger input (tim_trgi) reinitializes the counter,
generates an update of the registers, and starts the counter.
This mode is used for one-pulse mode.
